visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white button-down shirt and black pants, walks onto a spacious observation deck. The deck features a distinctive ceiling constructed from light-toned wooden slats arranged in a parallel fashion, creating a warm, Japanese-inspired atmosphere. In the background, a wide panorama of Hiroshima city under bright daylight is visible through the open-sided structure. (2) The scene transitions to several scenic cuts, including a high-angle view of the iconic Atomic Bomb Dome ruins surrounded by greenery and a river, followed by wide panoramic shots of the modern city skyline against distant mountains. The lighting is bright and natural, with the sun casting soft shadows across the urban landscape. (3) The woman is then seen walking through an indoor space where the walls are adorned with colorful murals of flowers and birds. She interacts with a large digital interactive screen and is later shown in a close-up shot meticulously folding a small red paper crane. She carefully drops the crane into a tall glass enclosure that is already filled with thousands of other multi-colored paper cranes, symbolizing peace and remembrance. The video concludes with an exterior shot of the modern tower building in the sunlight.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main character is a young woman with long, dark hair secured with a clip. She wears a casual yet clean style featuring a white long-sleeved button-down shirt tucked into black trousers, paired with a small brown leather crossbody bag.

It uses a serene, high-quality visual style and peaceful BGM to create an appealing and informative travel recommendation.
